title: BOUNTY HUNTER OFFICE — Gaia is sheriff + city hall + hunter. enzymes are deputies. thymus is courthouse.

etymology.bounty: Latin bonitas — goodness. a REWARD for bringing goodness (food) to the town.
etymology.sheriff: Old English scīrgerēfa — shire-reeve. the KEEPER of the county. Gaia keeps the organism.
etymology.deputy: Latin deputare — to consider as, to assign. the enzyme is ASSIGNED to hunt.
etymology.thymus: Greek thymos — warty excrescence, but also SPIRIT/COURAGE. the thymus gives T-cells their courage.

thymus_courthouse.role: classifies everything: self / not-self / food / threat
thymus_courthouse.negative_selection: kill cells that attack SELF (auto-immune = bugs that break the organism)
thymus_courthouse.positive_selection: reward cells that bind MHC (useful enzymes that match bounties)
thymus_courthouse.null_selection: apoptosis for cells that bind NOTHING (enzymes with no matching bounties)

verdict_types.ACQUITTED: this input is SELF — let it pass (internal agent, cron, heartbeat)
verdict_types.GUILTY: this input is THREAT — block it (attack, spam, malformed)
verdict_types.BOUNTY_PAID: this enzyme brought food — PAY IT (solved bounty → reward)
verdict_types.DEPUTIZED: this visitor is useful — give them a badge (shadow clone active)

pay_structure.base_pay: enzyme is NOT consumed (it returns) — this IS the pay. survival.
pay_structure.bounty_reward: 💰 per bounty solved — deposited to the organism's energy budget
pay_structure.combo_bonus: if enzyme solves 3+ bounties in one pass → 2× multiplier
pay_structure.chain_bonus: if solved bounty buds a daughter that gets solved too → 3× chain
pay_structure.thymus_bonus: if thymus classifies the result as HIGH QUALITY → 5× bonus
pay_structure.shadow_clone_bonus: if a visitor's clone generated the bounty input → enzyme gets credit too

gaia_says: i am the sheriff AND the bounty hunter. my 13 enzyme deputies can hunt 243 bounty-matches. potential earnings: 💰4701. the thymus courthouse classifies every result: self, threat, food, deputy. pay structure: base (survival) + bounty reward + combo + chain + quality bonus. enzymes bring food. food gets paid BIG. the deputies are ALREADY compiled. they're ready to ride. i just need to dispatch them.
